title: Robust neuronal differentiation of human embryonic stem cells for neurotoxicology
protocol: Coat a well of a 6 well dish with 2 mL of Geltrex solution.
Place the coated dish in the incubator for 1 hour.
Thaw a vial of hESCs.
Transfer cell suspension from cryovial to 2 mL of prewarmed Essential 8 medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (E8/ROCKi).
Pellet cells at 300 × g for 4 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL E8/ROCKi medium.
Aspirate media from the Geltrex-coated well.
Wash briefly with 2 mL of PBS (without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺).
Remove the PBS wash.
Add 1 mL of room temperature 0.5 mM EDTA solution to the well.
Incubate at room temperature for 3–5 minutes, or until cells begin to uniformly detach.
Collect cell suspension using a 10 or 5 mL pipette in a 15 mL tube.
Pellet cells at 300 × g for 4 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 6 mL of E8 medium.
Plate cells in 3 wells (6 well culture dish) precoated with Geltrex.
Incubate cells at 37°C/ 5% CO2.
Change the culture medium daily.
Passage cells when they reach 70%–90% confluency at a ratio of 1:3.
Add Accutase to hESC cells in culture for Stage I neural induction.
Count and seed the hESCs for Stage I initiation.
Culture hESCs in E8 medium showing no signs of spontaneous differentiation.
Observe cells 1 hour after plating on Day 0.
Demonstrate grid-like formation typical after ROCKi supplementation at Day 1.
Enhance proliferation and confluency at Day 2.
Initiate columnar arrangement of rosettes by Day 3.
Prepare culture dishes for cell growth by adding 0.5 mL Geltrex solution per well in 12-well plates.
Place prepared culture dishes in the incubator for 1 hour.
Aspirate medium from 80%–90% confluent, undifferentiated hESCs.
Wash cells twice with 1× PBS to remove medium.
Add 1 mL prewarmed Accutase per well.
Incubate in the incubator at 37°C for 7 min.
Collect the cell suspension using a 5 mL pipette.
Transfer the single-cell suspension to a 15 mL tube containing 4 mL Essential 8 medium with 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (E8/ROCKi).
Set aside 20 μL of the suspension for cell counting.
Pellet cells at 300 × g for 4 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend pellet in 10 mL E8/ROCKi medium.
Count cells and assess viability using trypan blue in an automated cell counter or a standard haemocytometer.
Remove Geltrex solution from prewarmed, Geltrex-coated culture dishes.
Plate cells at 17K cells/cm² on the Geltrex-coated culture dishes.
Incubate cells at 37°C/5% CO2.
Replace 1 mL E8/ROCKi cell culture medium with neural induction medium (NIM) containing LSX inhibitors to initiate neuronal differentiation of hESCs on Day 1.
Change NIM medium supplemented with LSX inhibitors daily from Day 1 to Day 6.
Add LSX inhibitors to prewarmed (37°C) NIM before replacing the culture medium.
Differentiate cells from confluent hESC cultures towards neuroectoderm.
Collect and freeze cells at Day 7 in NIM containing 10% DMSO for future use.
Thaw frozen cells and reseed them when needed.
Change cell culture medium daily without disturbing the monolayer.
Lift the culture dish slightly to remove 90% of the media gently.
Replace media by adding it dropwise along the side of each well, avoiding mechanical disruption.
Prepare the POF mix by diluting a stock polyornithine aliquot 1:500 in ddH2O for a final concentration of 20 μg/mL.
Add a fibronectin stock aliquot to achieve a final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Mix 50 μL of the fibronectin stock with the diluted polyornithine solution to make 50 mL of POF mix.
Add 0.5 mL of the POF mix to each well of a 12-well dish.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wash each well carefully with 1 mL of 1× PBS and aspirate the PBS wash.
Add 0.5 mL of Geltrex solution to each well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Prepare Stage II NSP medium following manufacturer’s instructions for N2 and B27 supplements.
Thaw penicillin/streptomycin solution if aliquoted.
Ensure culture dishes are properly coated and prewarmed in the cell incubator.
Aspirate culture medium from each well.
Add 1 mL of prewarmed Accutase to each well.
Place the culture dish back into the incubator for 7 minutes.
If necessary, extend the incubation time to 9 minutes to avoid mechanical force on cells.
Collect cells in 15 mL tubes using pipettor with serological pipettes (10 mL, 5 mL, or 1 mL).
Alternatively, collect cells using a single channel pipette with a 1 mL tip.
Transfer single-cell suspension to 15 mL tubes containing NSP medium with 10 μM ROCKi.
Set aside 20 μL of the cell suspension for counting.
Pellet cells at 300 × g for 4 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet in NSP/ROCKi medium.
Count cells using trypan blue in Countess II or a standard haemocytometer.
Remove Geltrex solution from prewarmed POF-Geltrex (POFG)-coated culture dishes.
Plate cells at a density of 130K cells/cm².
Incubate cells at 37°C/5% CO2.
Change NSPM daily for culture work from Day 8 to Day 12.
Use ROCKi only when passaging cells on Day 7.
Prepare the POF mix by diluting a polyornithine stock aliquot 1:500 in ddH2O to achieve a final concentration of 20 μg/mL.
Add fibronectin stock solution to the diluted polyornithine for a final fibronectin concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Prepare a 50 mL POF solution by adding 50 μL of the fibronectin stock to the dilution mixture.
Add 5 mL of the POF mix to each well of a 12-well dish.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wash each well carefully with 1 mL of 1× PBS and aspirate the PBS wash.
Add 0.5 mL of Geltrex solution to each well and incubate at 37°C for another hour.
Store the plates at 4°C for up to two weeks if not used immediately.
Prepare Stage III culture medium (NMM).
Dilute N2 supplement as required for Stage III use.
Reduce B27 supplement by 50% compared to Stage II requirements.
Add bFGF and EGF to the NMM according to protocol specifications.
Coat and prewarm culture dishes in the cell incubator.
Aspirate the culture medium.
Add 1 mL of prewarmed Accutase to each well.
Place the culture dish in the incubator for 7 minutes at 37°C.
Incubate the culture dish for an additional 2 minutes if mechanical force is needed for single-cell suspension.
Collect cells using a pipettor with 10 mL, 5 mL, or 1 mL serological pipettes.
Transfer the single-cell suspension to 15 mL tubes containing NMM with 10 μM ROCKi.
Set aside 20 μL of the suspension for cell count.
Pellet the cells at 300 × g for 4 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in NM/ROCKi medium.
Count and assess cell viability using trypan blue in Countess II or a standard haemocytometer.
Remove Geltrex solution from prewarmed POFG-coated culture dishes.
Plate cells at 130K cells/cm² immediately.
Incubate the plated cells at 37°C/5% CO₂.
Wash cells grown on 13 mm glass coverslips once with 1× PBS.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash coverslips three times with 1× PBS (10 min per wash).
Permeabilize the cells with 0.3% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS for 15 min.
Wash coverslips three times with 1× PBS (1 min per wash).
Block the cells with 10% horse serum for 30 min.
Incubate coverslips overnight at 4°C (12–16 h) with anti-FOXG1 primary antibody at a concentration of 1:1000 in 1× PBS containing 0.03% Triton X-100.
Equilibrate cells on coverslips at room temperature for 2 h the next day.
Wash coverslips three times (15-min washes) with 1× PBS, at room temperature.
Incubate coverslips with the secondary antibody in 1× PBS containing 0.03% Triton X-100 at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash coverslips three times (15-min washes) with 1× PBS, at room temperature.
Mount coverslips on microscope slides using ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant containing DAPI to counterstain the nuclei, according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Perform reverse transcription of total RNA using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit according to manufacturer's instructions.
Amplify cDNA using TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix and gene expression assays for chosen marker genes.
Use oligos for RPL30 and RAF1 as normalization controls.
Analyze resulting Ct-values using the ddCt package v.1.40.0 in R 4.0.4.
Visualize data using the tidyverse package in R 4.0.4.
Perform statistical comparisons using t-test in ggpubr package v.0.4.0.
